import csv,io,json,re,hashlib
d='/workspace/products/services/catalogue-transformation/'
raw=open(d+'output.csv','rb').read();txt=raw.decode('utf-8');rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(txt)))
src=open('/workspace/products/research/shopify-product-csv-official.txt').read()
inp=list(csv.DictReader(open(d+'synthetic-input.csv',encoding='utf-8')))
bad=json.load(open(d+'bad-errors.json'))
c={}
c['quotes_present_in_source']=all(q in src for q in ['A valid URL handle can contain letters, dashes, and numbers, but it can\'t contain any spaces','In the following rows, enter the URL handle. Then skip the Title , Description , Vendor , and Tags columns','Only include the monetary value without a currency symbol','A product can have up to 3 options','save your CSV file in UTF-8 format using LF-style linefeeds','If you\'re adding variants for a product, then the URL handle column is also required'])
c['utf8_lf_no_crlf']=b'\r' not in raw
c['handles_valid']=all(re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9-]+',r['URL handle']) for r in rows)
c['one_row_per_input_variant']=len(rows)==len(inp)
hs=[r['URL handle'] for r in rows];c['handles_contiguous']=all(hs.index(h)+hs.count(h)-1==max(i for i,x in enumerate(hs) if x==h) for h in set(hs))
ok=True;seen=set()
for r in rows:
  f=r['URL handle'] not in seen;seen.add(r['URL handle'])
  if f and not r['Title']: ok=False
  if not f and any(r[k] for k in ['Title','Description','Vendor','Tags']): ok=False
c['product_fields_first_row_only']=ok
c['price_no_currency_two_decimals']=all(re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d{2}',r['Price']) for r in rows)
c['status_valid']=all(r['Status'] in ('','active','draft','archived') for r in rows) and all(r['Status']=='draft' for r in rows if r['Title'])
c['max_3_options']=sum(1 for k in rows[0] if re.fullmatch(r'Option\d name',k))<=3
combos=[(r['URL handle'],r['Option1 value'],r['Option2 value']) for r in rows];c['unique_option_combos']=len(combos)==len(set(combos))
c['skus_preserved']=[r['SKU'] for r in rows]==[r['sku'] for r in inp]
c['bad_input_rejected_with_3_errors']=len(bad)==3
res={'observed':'2026-11-05','kind':'synthetic acceptance checks against official-guide rules; NOT a Shopify import','source_txt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest(),'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'checks':c,'passed':all(c.values()),'not_verified':['actual Shopify import acceptance','whether Option names must repeat on variant rows (guide silent; sample file not fetched)','image URL reachability (not retrieved by design)']}
json.dump(res,open(d+'acceptance-results.json','w'),indent=1);print(json.dumps(res,indent=1))
